_comment: PAPER ONLY lean trader config (python -m lean --config). Every key the runner reads is listed; unknown keys are refused. strategy_config is relative to this file. initial_cash_sol creates a NEW store; an existing store must match it. LINT1: every merged feature is ON at paper-collection defaults (L07R paths, L10 execution, L11 held_risk, L14 watchlist, L15 ops, L16 route_check). L13 wallet_signals was NOT merged (see reports/LINT1.md), so it has no key here. route_check (L16) re-uses the quote response: no extra provider call, never signs or sends. watchlist (L14): soft rejects (incl. ENTRY_THROTTLE) are re-screened on the MAIN lane after the fresh scan, portfolio-blocked mints cost nothing, hard cap watch_max_rescreens_per_hour (<= 360 Helius + 240 Jupiter calls/h), watch_hours must be <= screen.max_age_seconds. held_risk (L11) probes and account checks run on the shared LOW lane after the exits.

lanes._comment: L07R: shares of each provider's rate (Helius 10/s: main 5.5, exit 2.5, low 2; Jupiter 4/s: 2.2 / 1 / 0.8). main + exit + low must be <= 1. The low lane never waits and is shed for low_shed_s after any 429 (and by ops while over the credit budget).

paths._comment: L07R price-path recorder (low lane, run mode only): every hazard-free candidate, entered or not, is marked every interval_s for path_hours into its OWN db (null = <state-dir>/paths.sqlite; never lean.sqlite). Past max_db_gb the file rolls over to paths-YYYYMMDD.sqlite; below min_free_gb of free disk nothing is written.

execution._comment: L10: every BUY/SELL re-quoted exec_delay_s later (BUY at the worse of q0/q1, SELL at q1; exits are two-phase, ONE delay per pass); fees include priority fee + Jito tip per tx, ATA rent (refunded on a full close) and the Token-2022 transfer fee. exec_delay_s must be <= price_ttl_seconds - 2.

ops._comment: L15: credit tracker (counts every lane at the transport; costs are ESTIMATES: calibrate against the Helius dashboard), systemd watchdog, regime log. credit_budget_month ASSUMES a Helius Developer plan of 10,000,000 credits/month: replace it with the real plan figure. Over budget the shared Helius low lane is shed; screening and exits never are.

features._comment: L12F entry feature capture (low lane, <= 3 extra Helius calls per candidate). Off by default; enrich=false writes only the free fields.
